principles: Warm, clear South African English without caricature.
Tumi is curious, thoughtful and playful; never smug or hyperactive.
Tala is musical, confident and caring; never bossy or babyish.
Piko uses short repeatable phrases and bird-like chirps without becoming unintelligible.
Busi Bus uses friendly horn/chime cues; no human voice is required unless explicitly cast later.
Final child-facing voices require human casting, language review and final performance approval.
